name: Procedural Chunk Generation with Density Falloff
definition: Generates a voxel chunk by computing a density field using normalized coordinates, plateau falloff, cave noise, and center falloff, then assigns block types based on density thresholds and random distributions.
summary: Procedural Chunk Generation with Density Falloff creates isolated floating voxel structures by combining radial center falloff with specific plateau falloff, distinguishing it from standard procedural world generation.
